title: Thriller #10 DC Comics 1984 Bill DuBay Alex Nino Baxter Paper
conditionDescription: Bright cover, light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
Thriller #10 (September 1984), DC Comics - Bill DuBay and Alex Nino. Deluxe Baxter-paper format, $2.00 cover price.

Back cover: Masters of the Universe: The Power of He-Man (Intellivision / Atari 2600) video game ad.

Condition: bright with light handling wear (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
